Crea o elige un token y aquí verás cuánd: Create or pick a token and you will see here when the agent makes its first recall.
Choose your agent and copy what it needs. The step turns green when the agent makes its first recall, and the panel then lets you try what it receives.
Escribe el código de inicio: el instalad: Enter the first-start code: the installer printed it when it finished («First-start code: …»). If you did not use the installer, it is in the container's log:
Esperando el primer recall del agente…: Waiting for the agent's first recall…
Recalls hechos con «{{name}}» hasta ahor: Recalls made with «{{name}}» so far: {{n}}; the last one on {{at}}.
Your agent has made its first recall. Press «Finish» to go to the home screen.
Ábrelo en cuanto esté instalado y escríb: Open it once it is installed and send it a first message; with an MCP client without a plugin, ask it something it should look up in MimirSynth. This turns green a few seconds after its first recall.
